messages:
marta: Heads-up — a few customers hit failures when using the batching helper for embeddings + rerank. Getting a vector-dims mismatch error.
kevin: Repro steps? which SDK and which model alias?
sam: +1 which endpoint? embeddings or rerank?
marta: python SDK calling /v1/embeddings (model: all-mpnet-base-v2). When I batch 4 inputs the helper stacks them and we get: 'VectorDimensionsError: expected 768 but got 512' — happens intermittently.
linus: can you paste the client snippet?
marta: ```python
# simplified
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
inputs = ["a","b","c","d"]
embs = client.embeddings.batch_create(model='all-mpnet-base-v2', inputs=inputs, batch_size=4)
# embs -> we expect shape (4,768) but one of the items is 512
```
marta: error trace: ```
VectorDimensionsError: embeddings[2] dimension 512 != expected 768
  at batching_helper (/usr/src/app/sdk/embeddings.py:118)
  at RedwoodClient.embeddings.batch_create (/usr/src/app/sdk/client.py:422)
```
docs-bot: Note: there are two different flavors of response formats across SDKs right now — py returns {"data": [{"embedding": [...]}],...} while js returns an array of embeddings directly. That complicates helpers.
kevin: Sounds like two issues: (A) inconsistent response normalization across SDKs, (B) batching helper not validating per-item dims before stacking. Actionable: 1) add per-item dim assert in batching helper + clearer error message, 2) normalize response -> canonical list of vectors in each SDK, 3) add model->dim lookup fallback when server does not return dims.
linus: I'll add the assert and a unit test. If dims differ we should include the model name and raw dims in the error so users can map to the right embedding model. ETA EOD.
sam: Also observed that large batches sometimes get transient 429s; we should ensure the helper supports backoff/retries with idempotency key. Might be surface-level DX issue (auth/retry behavior) when users do naive loops.
infra-bot: Created issue infra#456: "embeddings batching: validate dims, SDK response parity, and retry/backoff for large batches" — linked logs and a few repro traces.
marta: assigning to @kevin and @linus for SDKs, @sam for retry/backoff. I'll prepare a short docs PR to add a 'Model dims' table and example error FAQ. Thanks all :raised_hands:
